scope: Bounded planning review only, not theorem proof, new SAU admission, or Statement Seal acceptance.
overall: No counterexample to the stated fixed-horizon strict-terminal-survival joint complete-history/coordinate-path law was found. The seven inspected public interfaces supply the advertised mathematical parents. No additional analytic source hypothesis is needed. One currently implicit measurable-history-to-path adapter should be made explicit before sealing, and all listed adapters remain unproved obligations.

interface_assessment.provides: For every fixed deterministic depth n and every measurable full-history duration d:Hist_n->NNReal, joint survival event measurability, measurable weight<=1, and an unnormalized probability identity on every measurable history set. Stopped records give false survival and zero weight.
interface_assessment.does_not_provide: An arbitrary weighted history-test equality or any path-functional law directly. Duration must be constructed measurable internally; it is not a new public hypothesis.

interface_assessment.provides: For each fixed y,r,z0, one AE event common to every finite time, with unique interval index and live record/strict residual waiting-time characterization.
interface_assessment.does_not_provide: Absence of a jump at a given deterministic T, nor positivity of all raw thresholds pointwise. Its parameter quantifier is outside AE.

interface_assessment.provides: A single existential Z jointly measurable in parameters,time,input, chosen before all parameter/time conclusions; interpolation on every covered interval is pointwise for arbitrary raw samples, with explicit uncovered fallback.
interface_assessment.does_not_provide: A pre-existing path-valued random variable, its Skorokhod-Borel regularity, or a provider that may be assumed in a new public theorem.

interface_assessment.provides: Exact strict-prefix full-history tests/law, joint K/q, subtype Lebesgue, and pointwise complete-history reconstruction on B_n.
interface_assessment.does_not_provide: Terminal survival, exact finite count, fixed-horizon endpoint atomlessness, or whole-path identification.

interface_assessment.provides: Total measurable records/event times, initial zero time, monotonicity, absorbing top, and strictly increasing live updates when the corresponding threshold is positive.
interface_assessment.does_not_provide: Strict updates for arbitrary raw samples containing zero/nonpositive real clocks.

interface_assessment.provides: Literal P probability and one AE event where all real coordinates are positive and equal their NNReal coercions.
interface_assessment.does_not_provide: A pointwise positive-clock constraint on all raw samples.

interface_assessment.provides: Existing per-parameter AE all-horizon finite event-time sets; available through79.
interface_assessment.does_not_provide: A new premise to add or a result to re-award as new93 progress.

required_internal_obligations.obligation: Construct total d_T(h)=T-lastLiveTime(h) with a specified NNReal observer on stopped records; prove measurable. From88 with A intersected with the Borel strict-history guard, derive equality of restricted history measures, then equality for arbitrary ENNReal history tests. Combine92 with the measurable test times survival weight.
required_internal_obligations.reason: 88 is set-law only. No fresh independence/restart theorem is needed, but the weighted extension is genuine mathematical work.

required_internal_obligations.obligation: Construct a TOTAL measurable Psi_n,T:Hist_n->Path_T, with deterministic fallback for malformed/stopped/initial-time-nonzero histories. For each coordinate s, choose the greatest eligible live record index with time<=s and interpolate; on K_n(t), prove Psi(K_n(t))=Gamma_n,T(t). On C_n prove Psi(H_n)=Z_T pointwise as functions. Then G(h)=F(h,Psi(h)) is a measurable HISTORY test consumable by88/92.
required_internal_obligations.reason: Measurability of Gamma on the simplex alone does not automatically make an arbitrary F(H_n,Z_T) a history-measurable integrand. The candidate mentions interpolation but should name this total factorization obligation explicitly before sealing. A measurable extension through the K image is an alternative, also requiring proof.

required_internal_obligations.obligation: Define the fixed carrier concretely as functions from {s:NNReal // s<=T} to Phase with the product measurable space. Prove coordinate-wise Gamma and Psi measurability. Use80 pointwise covered-arc formulas and92 history reconstruction with finite partition indices to prove extensional equality for every s simultaneously on each raw C_n.
required_internal_obligations.reason: No uncountable AE intersection is permitted or necessary. Measurability of the diagonal/equality set in an arbitrary uncountable product should not be assumed; prove equality on the already measurable C_n by function extensionality.

required_internal_obligations.obligation: For fixed parameters and fixed T>0, positive clocks plus finite T_j imply the first j records are a strict prefix below T+1. Apply92 with the final-time=T history indicator; identify its pullback with the last-coordinate hyperplane, prove ambient product-Lebesgue zero, then comap restriction and density zero. Treat j>=1, T=0 using positive-clock strictness. Take a countable union over j only.
required_internal_obligations.reason: The correct order is forall parameters,T, AE w, forall j>=1. Never AE w, forall T or AE w, forall parameters.

required_internal_obligations.obligation: Let I_n={T_n<=T<T_(n+1)}. Prove each measurable and pairwise disjoint from monotonicity; define the unique-index/zero-fallback count measurably. For a Nat.find proof, incorporate the measurable uncovered fallback or restrict to the countable-union coverage domain; measurable_find requires an existence proof on its entire input domain. Intersect79 coverage, all-clock positivity and fixed-T no-endpoint event. Derive N=n iff C_n simultaneously over n, finite <T and <=T counts, disjointness and full-measure union.
required_internal_obligations.reason: The selector may be total while its event-count interpretation is only AE. Existing79 already supplies the AE existence, so no public coverage or positive-mass premise is admissible.

required_internal_obligations.obligation: Use the measurable history test G from the total path adapter and the terminally weighted92 law, then replace C_n by {N=n} modulo their AE symmetric difference and replace paths pointwise on C_n. Prove rho=q*ofReal(exp(-Lambda)) using nonnegative/finite real factors.
required_internal_obligations.reason: Arbitrary infinite ENNReal tests are valid and zero-mass count events require no normalization. Measurable compositions and AE-set replacement must be supplied internally.

quantifier_audit: Retain exactly the six original analytic assumptions and structural finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel instances. No path law, survival law, independent clocks, positivity, nonexplosion, cap or measurable-selector certificate becomes a public premise.

Choose the jointly parameterized theorem80 witness Z once before the fixed-parameter and horizon conclusions, or state an existential strengthened witness. Separately choosing arbitrary Z after each parameter would lose the advertised joint measurability.

With V,alpha,beta,eta fixed, joint finite-parameter measurability is compatible with each fixed-T product path carrier. A claim jointly varying T has dependent path carriers and needs a separate representation; it is not part of this acceptance.

Path equality on raw C_n is pointwise for all coordinates simultaneously. Endpoint-null and count interpretation are for each fixed horizon on a parameter-dependent full-measure event. No common no-jump-at-any-time event is claimed.
zero_and_density_audit: n=0,T=0: empty simplex mass1, q0=1, terminal exp(-Lambda(z0,0))=1. C0(0) has probability1 but is not all raw samples. N0=0 and initial path hold AE. For n>0,T=0 the strict simplex and C_n are empty and the {N=n} side has zero measure.
n=0,T>0: total mass is the first-wait survival exp(-Lambda(z0,T)), generally less than1; the zero-event density must not be confused with prefix92 q0=1.

At rank zero, or an initial zero-rate trajectory with no finite positive-clock event, count0 has probability1 and positive-count densities vanish. WithTop infinity passes every finite strict-survival test and remains a last-live arc, not fallback.

rho contains exactly n completed-segment survival factors plus one terminal survival. No factor n!, no simplex normalization, no terminal bounce rate, and no division by the count-event probability are warranted.

For internal jumps s=t_j choose j, preserving post-bounce/right-continuous values. At T the last completed state flows for T-t_n, because C_n requires strict next-wait survival. The half-open real intervals and NNReal subtraction agree on support.

counterexamples.model: E=R, V(x)=x^2/2, alpha=beta=eta=1, y=r=0, z0=(1,1); w(0)=0 and later thresholds positive.
counterexamples.calculation: tau(z0,0)=0, so R1=live(0,(1,-1)). At T=0, C0(0) is false; the covered-interval selector gives N0=1 and80 gives the post-bounce phase (1,-1).
counterexamples.excludes: Pointwise C0(0)=univ, pointwise N0=0, pointwise Z(0)=z0, or equating raw event count with strict-prefix count without the AE positive-clock event.
counterexamples.candidate_status: Already excluded by the candidate AE caveat.

counterexamples.model: Same one-dimensional model; take T=pi/12 and first threshold e0=1/4.
counterexamples.calculation: Before pi/4, rate(Phi_s z0)=cos(2s), Lambda(s)=sin(2s)/2, hence tau=T. Phi_T z0=(sqrt(6)/2,sqrt(2)/2); its reflection is (sqrt(6)/2,-sqrt(2)/2). A weak survival T<=tau admits this raw sample to the zero-event side, but actual Z(T) is post-bounce while Gamma0(T) is pre-bounce.
counterexamples.excludes: Replacing strict survival by weak survival while retaining pointwise whole-path identity.
counterexamples.candidate_status: Strict comparison correctly prevents the counterexample; fixed-T endpoint nullity can only justify an AE replacement.

counterexamples.calculation: On 0<e0<1/2, which has probability 1-exp(-1/2)>0, a first event occurs at some T1 in (0,pi/4). Thus the event that no jump occurs at any real horizon T cannot have probability1.
counterexamples.excludes: Moving forall T inside the endpoint-null AE assertion.
counterexamples.candidate_status: The stated forall fixed T then AE order is correct.

carrier_audit: Coordinate-product measurable paths are an explicit carrier completion. They support arbitrary coordinate-measurable functionals without needing Skorokhod/cadlag theory. Do not call this all Borel functionals of an unspecified path topology; such an upgrade requires regularity and sigma-algebra compatibility proofs.
